title: Chapter 369 Abandoning Order
content:
Chapter 369 Abandoning Order

On the other side, Lu Daosheng had already set foot on the road and walked towards the depths of the chaos.

At this moment, his mind suddenly moved slightly.

The next moment, a figure appeared beside him.

Jiang Xiaoxiao.

"Brother Sheng, I, I can't stay mine anymore."

Jiang Xiaoxiao's eyes were slightly red and her expression was very aggrieved.

Lu Daosheng threw her into the unknown world and then ignored her.

Although she has no worries about food and clothing and has abundant resources, she can't stand it even if she keeps her inside.

Seeing Jiang Xiaoxiao like this, a hint of apology flashed in Lu Daosheng's eyes.

"Xiaoxiao, sorry, I didn't care about your feelings."

It was then that he suddenly realized that Jiang Xiaoxiao was born and raised by Blue Star, just like him.

It would be extremely boring to let her practice in it.

This is just like learning.

Although you know that studying hard will lead to good grades, how many students can continue to study hard.

These days, Jiang Xiaoxiao probably has been suffocated.

Looking at Jiang Xiaoxiao, Lu Daosheng pondered for a moment.

"Let me do this Xiaoxiao, I will give you a task, and you can help me complete it, how about it?"

Task?

Jiang Xiaoxiao's expression lit up and nodded constantly, "Okay, okay."

"Brother Sheng, don't worry, I will definitely do it."

Although I don’t know what the task is, I think Lu Daosheng will definitely not arrange anything too difficult for her.

Seeing Jiang Xiaoxiao being so excited, Lu Daosheng chuckled and said, "I left a force in one place called Huangcheng. You go and bring it over, and there is my wife."

As soon as these words came out, the smile on Jiang Xiaoxiao's face froze instantly.

After a long silence, Jiang Xiaoxiao came back to her senses.

"Brother Sheng, you, you actually have a wife!"

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng still smiled, "Yes, my daughter has grown up."

While speaking, before Jiang Xiaoxiao was shocked, Lu Daosheng had already walked in front of her and covered her Tianling cover with one hand.

The next moment, the gentle power continued to inject into Jiang Xiaoxiao's body.

At the same time, Jiang Xiaoxiao's aura began to soar.

Initiation!

This is a highly efficient but highly dangerous method of cultivation transmission.

Once there are subtle mistakes, people with low cultivation will risk being lost.

But there is no such thing as Lu Daosheng.

However, Lu Daosheng generally does not use this method to improve the strength of the people below him.

Because the initiation will affect the qualifications of the person who is initiated, it will become more and more difficult for subsequent cultivation.

However, Jiang Xiaoxiao was excluded.

Because Jiang Xiaoxiao does not have any cultivation qualifications, it was because Lu Daosheng used resources to force Jiang Xiaoxiao to raise her.

Therefore, this method of initiation is very suitable for Jiang Xiaoxiao.

I don’t know how long it took, but Lu Daosheng retracted his strength.

Jiang Xiaoxiao also slowly opened her eyes. At this moment, she felt that her whole body was full of strength.

She is still her, but it seems she is not her.

This feeling is very wonderful.

"Brother Sheng, I,"

"Do you really want to vent?"

Lu Daosheng asked with a chuckling.

"yes."

Jiang Xiaoxiao nodded, but for some reason, her face turned slightly red.

"Then go and bring the wasteland city to the Chaos Realm, where my daughter is."

Lu Daosheng has also instilled in Jiang Xiaoxiao's mind in the direction of the Chaos Realm.

Jiang Xiaoxiao agreed and asked again, "Then after I finish these things, will I still go to find you?"

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng pondered for a moment and finally said, "You can decide for yourself."

"Okay, Brother Sheng, then I'll leave."

"Be careful."

Then, Jiang Xiaoxiao broke through the space and disappeared directly here.

Watching Jiang Xiaoxiao leave, Lu Daosheng no longer stayed and continued to walk towards the depths of the chaos.

Buzz —

Jiang Xiaoxiao, who broke through the space, felt the scene of the surroundings constantly retreating like time and space, and Jiang Xiaoxiao was in a trance.

Once upon a time, she was a graduate who worked diligently.

Now, I have become a peerless master with great cultivation.

All of this is because of Lu Daosheng.

"Brother Sheng, don't worry, I will definitely complete the task you assigned me."

Suddenly, Jiang Xiaoxiao's speed also began to accelerate a few points.

I don't know how long it took.

Through the numerous spaces, Jiang Xiaoxiao finally came to a quiet starry sky.

After looking around, Jiang Xiaoxiao nodded slightly.

"This is probably what Brother Sheng said."

Click—

At this moment, the space around Jiang Xiaoxiao suddenly began to shatter, and then it fell into complete nirvana.

Seeing this scene, Jiang Xiaoxiao was slightly stunned and quickly held her breath.

She must restrain her breath, otherwise this space would not be able to accommodate her at all.

She is really too strong for here now.

It's not the same dimension at all.

"Go to that."

After looking around, Jiang Xiaoxiao rushed in one direction.

And at this time, it is far away.

A giant city shining with a sacred light has stood quietly here.

Since the last commotion, Yan Lingyun has come forward in person and soon shocked everyone.

The deserted city fell into peace again.

But everyone vaguely noticed that something was going to happen.

Somewhere in the deserted city.

A middle-aged man in elegant clothes was sitting in a pavilion, quietly drinking tea.

It is the master of the Time and Space Palace, and time and space win.

Since he came to the deserted city to seek the fruit of immortality, he has fallen in love with it. Because of An Xing's care, he was able to temporarily live in the deserted city.

"Life is just a big dream, and enjoyment is the true meaning."

Shikong Ying blew a sip of tea and sipped it, and immediately showed a comfortable expression.

At this moment, a figure suddenly appeared behind him.

Time and space win are unmoved.

"Brother Ying, you really enjoy it."

The figure behind him smiled and spoke.

Time and Space Win turned around and saw An Xing immediately.

After so long, An Xing still looked the same.

But Shi Space Win knows that this is a person with extremely delicate minds.

"Oh? It turns out it's Brother An. Come on, come on, sit down."

An Xing did not refuse and sat down.

"I wonder why Brother An came to see me today?"

Looking at An Xing, Shikong asked with a smile.

Upon hearing this, An Xing took a sip of tea and then said, "Brother Ying, you have to know that you are not from my desolate city. You have always been here, and it is not a solution, right?"

Time and space win and laugh without saying a word, but I was already worried.

It seems that An Xing has already begun to force him to take sides.

Not long ago, An Xing had already told him in a vague way whether to join the Huangcheng.

He was naturally very moved when he heard this news.

After all, he knew exactly what the conditions were in Huangcheng.

However, he couldn't bear to leave his time and space hall, and he would never pay off the kindness of Venerable Wuji to him in his life.

It was really hard for him to make a decision for a while when he asked him to abandon order and join the deserted city.
